lessons.title: Silent wait or deadlock
lessons.symptom: A lane stays idle while it waits for a reply, approval, or event that may never arrive; no new artifact or bounded next action appears.
lessons.invariant: A lane must not depend on an unbounded human or system response to make progress.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Set an explicit wait deadline and one blocker record; when the deadline is reached, stop and return a resumable handoff instead of polling.
lessons.recovery: Record what was checked, mark the blocker, release the scope, and resume only when a fresh bounded action is available.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A harness that withholds a reply observes a blocker and a released scope without an unbounded wait loop.

lessons.title: Repeated identical tool retries
lessons.symptom: The same command or request is issued again after the same failure without changing its input, environment, or diagnosis.
lessons.invariant: Each retry must be justified by a changed condition or a newly learned fact; a retry budget is finite.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Classify the failure, record the attempted input, and stop when the configured retry budget is exhausted or no meaningful change is possible.
lessons.recovery: Preserve the first useful error, correct the actual input once, then switch to a different bounded path or report the blocker.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A simulated repeated failure produces a finite attempt record and no further identical call after the retry budget is reached.

lessons.title: Wrong workspace or target
lessons.symptom: Commands inspect or change a different checkout, branch, project root, or revision than the task names.
lessons.invariant: Every read and write must be anchored to an explicitly verified target before mutation begins.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Record the current directory, repository identity, branch, and target revision at start; reject writes when any check disagrees.
lessons.recovery: Stop writes, preserve any uncommitted rescue data, compare the intended and actual targets, and continue only from the verified target.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A test substitutes a different directory or revision and proves the operation fails before changing a file.

lessons.title: Overlapping file lanes
lessons.symptom: Two active lanes claim the same file, a parent directory and its child, or equivalent paths written in different forms.
lessons.invariant: Active lanes must have unique, normalized, non-overlapping relative scopes.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Normalize separators and traversal, reject duplicate or nested scopes at reservation time, and keep one owner for each mutable scope.
lessons.recovery: Release the conflicting reservation, re-scope one lane to an independent area, and re-run the overlap check before resuming.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A reservation test rejects duplicate, parent-child, and normalized-equivalent scopes while accepting independent siblings.

lessons.title: Hierarchy or authority deadlock
lessons.symptom: Executors wait on one another for supervisory approval, a second key, or an authority that was never assigned.
lessons.invariant: One coordinator owns decisions; executors return evidence but cannot gate one another.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Assign one decision owner, give each executor a closed scope and terminal output, and prohibit approval chains that can wait indefinitely.
lessons.recovery: Remove the waiting edge, decide from the available artifacts, and issue at most one bounded correction with a clear owner.
lessons.testableAcceptance: Two independent lanes cannot block one another by withholding approval; a returned artifact is sufficient for the coordinator to decide.

lessons.title: Misleading diff or completion claims
lessons.symptom: A commit, diff, branch, or progress statement is described as fixed or complete despite unmerged, unrelated, or unverified changes.
lessons.invariant: A claim must match the observed diff and terminal evidence in the named target.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Compare the change summary with the actual diff, verify the target revision, and distinguish pending, landed, and verified states.
lessons.recovery: Correct the record, relabel pending work, and run the missing checks before making a completion claim.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A test with an unmerged change keeps the status pending until the target revision and required evidence match.

lessons.title: Unmerged branch or worktree accumulation
lessons.symptom: Branches or worktrees remain after a lane appears finished, making ownership, divergence, and cleanup unclear.
lessons.invariant: Every branch and worktree is temporary until it is merged and cleaned or explicitly abandoned and deleted.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Inventory active refs before new work, pair every lane with integration and cleanup, and delete only validated superseded surfaces.
lessons.recovery: For each stale surface choose merge, resume-and-clean, or abandon-and-delete; record the outcome before reusing its scope.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A close operation leaves no owned stale surface, or returns an explicit abandonment record with cleanup proof.

lessons.title: Dirty-work loss
lessons.symptom: A reset, cleanup, checkout, or overwrite erases uncommitted work before its owner can recover it.
lessons.invariant: Uncommitted state must be detected and preserved before any destructive operation.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Check cleanliness, create a patch or other rescue artifact, and fail closed if preservation cannot be verified before proceeding.
lessons.recovery: Restore from the rescue artifact, verify the recovered diff, and let the scope owner reclaim the lane before further mutation.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A test injects dirty files and proves a destructive operation is blocked unless a valid rescue artifact exists.

lessons.title: Unbounded token or tool spend
lessons.symptom: One item consumes increasing calls, tokens, or time without producing a committed artifact or a clear next command.
lessons.invariant: Each item has a finite budget and a stop condition tied to observable progress.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Record the start, budget, and produced artifact; stop at the configured limit or after repeated no-progress results and emit a blocker.
lessons.recovery: Summarize progress and the blocker, preserve useful artifacts, and split a fresh bounded follow-up instead of extending the same loop.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A simulated no-progress sequence stops at its configured budget and emits no extra calls after the stop condition.

lessons.title: Unsafe credential or login handling
lessons.symptom: A command prints, persists, or requests secret values, or attempts to automate a security challenge outside the approved path.
lessons.invariant: Secret values stay out of source, arguments, logs, receipts, and screenshots; human challenges fail closed.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Use secret references and redaction, rely on the service's own sign-in controls, and refuse to enter passwords, one-time codes, captchas, or passkeys.
lessons.recovery: Stop exposure, rotate or revoke the affected credential through an owner-controlled channel, scrub artifacts, and resume without secret values.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A test supplies a sentinel secret and confirms outputs and receipts contain only redacted placeholders while a challenge path stops.

lessons.title: Missing terminal evidence
lessons.symptom: Work is called done from a plan, branch, commit, passing local test, or status note alone.
lessons.invariant: Closure requires a target revision, relevant checks, redacted evidence, and a merge or deployment outcome, or explicit abandonment proof.
lessons.mechanicalControl: Require a machine-readable receipt listing the target, checks, evidence, and disposition; keep intermediate artifacts open.
lessons.recovery: Reopen the lane, collect the missing proof, or record an explicit abandon, delete, and clean result.
lessons.testableAcceptance: A validator rejects closure that lacks a terminal target, check result, redacted evidence, or abandonment proof.
